description: Issue #815: the other half of `spec/execution-model.md:761-765`. The same program as the Turtle & Rendering fixture, run under a profile set that does NOT claim Turtle & Rendering: `ol-bad-token` is still suppressed, and the did-you-mean is absent because `forward` is not visible to suggest. The answer depends on the run's own claim, which is why `executeOptions.profiles` names it here rather than leaving it to the implementation's default.
